purpose: Stable MaterialStateRef address binding exactly one native or scoped owner to one frozen material facet.

columns.name: native_owner_ref
columns.meaning: Native owner address when the facet belongs to a native owner.
columns.value_contract: Exactly one of native_owner_ref/scoped_owner_ref must be non-null.

columns.name: scoped_owner_ref
columns.meaning: Scoped owner address when the facet belongs to a scoped owner.
columns.value_contract: Exactly one of native_owner_ref/scoped_owner_ref must be non-null.

foreign_keys.name: fk_material_state_address_native_owner_ref_native_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind a native-owned material state to an existing NativeRef address.

foreign_keys.name: fk_material_state_address_scoped_owner_ref_scoped_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind a scoped-owned material state to an existing ScopedRecordRef address.

check_constraints.name: ck_material_state_address_one_owner
check_constraints.reason: A MaterialStateRef belongs to exactly one owner address space.

check_constraints.name: ck_material_state_address_facet_code
check_constraints.reason: Keep material-state addressing bounded to the five current materialized facets.

indexes.name: ix_material_state_address_native_owner_ref_facet_code
indexes.reason: Native owner + facet lookup and parent-check path.

indexes.name: ix_material_state_address_scoped_owner_ref_facet_code
indexes.reason: Scoped owner + facet lookup and parent-check path.

triggers.name: ctrg_material_state_address_state_totality
triggers.reason: Database-local enforcement that every MaterialStateRef address retains exactly one facet envelope.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Address row identifies the immutable MaterialStateRef even when protected payload is later retired.
state_history.current_binding: Current-control tables point to this address space, including an explicitly retired state when that remains the truthful current reference.
state_history.chronology: MaterialStateRef identity is not chronology; current/history tables carry temporal interpretation and retirement is recorded separately.
state_history.immutability_policy: No generic runtime UPDATE/DELETE surface; MaterialStateRef is not reused after retirement.

lifecycle.retention: Retain the address while reference/history continuity or anti-reuse obligations remain.
lifecycle.redaction: Protected facet payload may be removed without deleting this address.
lifecycle.retirement_tombstone: dante.material_state_retirement is keyed by this MaterialStateRef and makes payload absence explicit.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; retirement does not authorize MaterialStateRef reuse.
